message.content:
The value of a U.S. dollar in British pounds fluctuates daily with the foreign‑exchange market.  
As of the most recent rates (mid‑2026), the exchange rate is roughly:

| USD | GBP |
|-----|-----|
| 1   | 0.78 |

So, 20 USD would be about:

```
20 × 0.78 ≈ £15.60
```

**Note:** Exchange rates change constantly, so the exact amount you receive will depend on the rate at the time of your transaction and any fees your bank or service may charge. If you need a precise figure for a specific date or transaction, you can check a reliable financial news source, a currency‑conversion website, or your bank’s current rate.
